name: io.github.iowarp/hdf5-mcp
title: CLIO Hdf5
description: HDF5 FastMCP - Scientific Data Access for AI Agents | CLIO Kit MCP Server

tools.name: open_file
tools.description: Open an HDF5 file for operations.

tools.name: close_file
tools.description:
Close the current HDF5 file.

Returns:
    Status message

tools.name: get_filename
tools.description:
Get the current file's path.

Returns:
    File path

tools.name: get_mode
tools.description:
Get the current file's access mode.

Returns:
    File mode

tools.name: get_by_path
tools.description: Get a dataset or group by path.

tools.name: list_keys
tools.description: List keys in a group.

tools.name: visit
tools.description: Visit all nodes recursively.

tools.name: read_full_dataset
tools.description: Read an entire dataset with efficient chunked reading for large datasets.

tools.name: read_partial_dataset
tools.description: Read a portion of a dataset with slicing.

tools.name: get_shape
tools.description: Get the shape of a dataset.

tools.name: get_dtype
tools.description: Get the data type of a dataset.

tools.name: get_size
tools.description: Get the size of a dataset.

tools.name: get_chunks
tools.description: Get chunk information for a dataset.

tools.name: read_attribute
tools.description: Read an attribute from an object.

tools.name: list_attributes
tools.description: List all attributes of an object.

tools.name: hdf5_parallel_scan
tools.description: Fast multi-file scanning with parallel processing.

tools.name: hdf5_batch_read
tools.description: Read multiple datasets in parallel.

tools.name: hdf5_stream_data
tools.description: Stream large datasets efficiently with memory management.

tools.name: hdf5_aggregate_stats
tools.description: Parallel statistics computation across multiple datasets.

tools.name: analyze_dataset_structure
tools.description: Analyze and understand file organization and data patterns with AI insights.

tools.name: find_similar_datasets
tools.description: Find datasets with similar characteristics to a reference dataset with AI analysis.

tools.name: suggest_next_exploration
tools.description: Suggest interesting data to explore next based on current location with AI recommendations.

tools.name: identify_io_bottlenecks
tools.description: Identify potential I/O bottlenecks and performance issues with AI recommendations.

tools.name: optimize_access_pattern
tools.description: Suggest better approaches for data access based on usage patterns.

tools.name: refresh_hdf5_resources
tools.description:
Re-scan client roots and update available HDF5 resources.

FastMCP automatically sends notifications/resources/list_changed to clients.

Returns:
    Summary of refreshed resources

tools.name: list_available_hdf5_files
tools.description:
List all registered HDF5 files with resource URIs for Claude Code @ mentions.

Returns:
    List of available files with resource URIs

tools.name: export_dataset
tools.description: Export dataset to various formats with user format selection.

resource_templates.name: hdf5_file_metadata
resource_templates.description:
Expose HDF5 file metadata as resource.

Args:
    file_path: Path to HDF5 file

Returns:
    JSON metadata

resource_templates.name: hdf5_dataset_resource
resource_templates.description:
Expose HDF5 dataset as resource.

Args:
    file_path: Path to HDF5 file
    dataset_path: Path to dataset within file (supports nested paths)

Returns:
    Dataset data (preview for large datasets)

resource_templates.name: hdf5_structure_resource
resource_templates.description:
Expose HDF5 file structure as resource.

Args:
    file_path: Path to HDF5 file

Returns:
    Hierarchical structure

prompts.name: explore_hdf5_file
prompts.description: Generate workflow for exploring an HDF5 file.

prompts.name: optimize_hdf5_access
prompts.description: Generate optimization workflow for HDF5 I/O.

prompts.name: compare_hdf5_datasets
prompts.description: Generate comparison workflow for two datasets.

prompts.name: batch_process_hdf5
prompts.description: Generate batch processing workflow for multiple HDF5 files.
